chapter: Lu Barker and the Barbarin family
title: Deciding between Cab Calloway and a career for Lu
summary: Danny explains that Lu recorded before he joined Cab, and he chose the steadier income and prestige of Cab's band over promoting her.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Yes, to us. To us it's very important, you know. So Lu, you'd been married five years when Sylvia was born, huh?
That's when you all lived with Lizzie Miles?
That's when I got pregnant, we was living with Lizzie Miles, yes.
So you made that first record date with Danny. So Danny, you were with Cab then. How did you all start to decide to go professional with Lu?

Well, she could sing, and I heard other people singing, and she had all these songs she sang, all them Blues, and they were Blues that had some depth and guts to them, and I figured, well, you know, let her make some records.
Well, I had made those records when he had started with Cab. I had made those records...
That's why I had to decide between going with a career with her or going with Cab. So Cab looked more lucrative, and it was more prestige for me, too...
You'd have a steady income, too.
And as far as her career, it looked like we just couldn't get started. We tried bookings, and we...
